hooks.command: FILE=$(jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty' < /dev/stdin); [[ "$FILE" == *.py ]] || exit 0; cd "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" && { uv run ruff check --fix "$FILE" 2>/dev/null || true; uv run ruff format "$FILE" 2>/dev/null || true; }

[[ -z "$CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT" ]] && exit 0; echo "$CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT" | grep -qP 'rm\s+-(r|f|rf|fr|Rf|rF)\b|DROP\s+TABLE|git\s+push\s+.*--force(?!-with-lease)\b|git\s+reset\s+--hard|git\s+clean\s+-[a-z]*f|git\s+branch\s+-D' && echo 'BLOCK: destructive command (best-effort guard)' >&2 && exit 2 || true
